result.rationale: The diff line `offset = Math.min(group.get("offset") + group.get("limit"), group.get("user_count"))` clamps to user_count instead of the last page boundary. Combined with `totalPages = Math.floor(user_count/limit) + 1`, when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 with limit 50), next navigates from offset 50 to offset 100, which is an empty page yet reported as currentPage == totalPages — an off-by-one the correct clamp `user_count - (user_count % limit)` would avoid. The mechanism cited is real and verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `next` action clamps `offset` with `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, which allows `offset` to become exactly `user_count`. Since `Group.findMembers` sends that `offset` through to `/groups/:name/members.json`, this can request an empty page (offset at end of dataset). This is especially reachable because `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 100/50 => 3), enabling navigation to the extra empty page where `offset == user_count` and `currentPage` becomes that extra page.
